name: devin-bundle
description: Devin CLI bundle: skills I use + consolidated rules. Cross-platform installer. Unified and adapted engineering + productivity skill sets.

skills.name: ask-bundle
skills.purpose: Use when deciding which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo — maps idea-to-ship flows, on-ramps, and standalone tools.

skills.name: code-review
skills.purpose: Use when completing a task, reviewing a branch or PR, before merging, or when the user asks to 'review since X'.

skills.name: context7
skills.purpose: Use when the user asks about a library, framework, or component and up-to-date docs would help.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.purpose: Use when facing two or more independent tasks with no shared state or ordering.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.purpose: Use when building or refining a project's domain model, glossary, or bounded contexts.

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.purpose: Use when the implementation is complete, all tests pass, and the work needs to be integrated.

skills.name: gh
skills.purpose: Use when interacting with GitHub via the gh CLI from an agent.

skills.name: grilling
skills.purpose: Use when exploring and stress-testing ideas before committing to a design or plan.

skills.name: handoff
skills.purpose: Use when the user needs to compact the current conversation into a document for another agent to continue.

skills.name: jira
skills.purpose: Use when the user asks to interact with Jira — search issues, read or update tickets, transition status, add comments, list projects, or run JQL. Routes operations through the Atlassian Rovo MCP server (mcp__atlassian__* tools).

skills.name: mutation-testing
skills.purpose: Use when the user asks to find testing gaps, mutation test, or identify surviving mutants.

skills.name: observability-quality
skills.purpose: Use when adding logging, metrics, distributed tracing, error monitoring, linting, architecture testing, or test infrastructure to a project. Covers OpenTelemetry, Sentry/Datadog/Grafana, Biome/ESLint, ArchUnit, commitlint, Knip, Playwright, and coverage strategy.

skills.name: primeagent-reference
skills.purpose: Use when (1) researching agent harness design patterns, comparing Devin CLI to PrimeAgent/RLM architectures, or evaluating which PrimeAgent features could be adapted to Devin CLI; (2) emulating A2A messaging between subagents or between subagents and the parent agent across time within Devin CLI's ephemeral subagent runtime; (3) capturing recurring failure patterns or reusable tactics as skills/rules/hooks via the Continual Harness /refine self-improvement loop; or (4) deciding whether to dispatch a subagent, which profile to use, and how many concurrent agents to run (subagent dispatch profile/budget selection).

skills.name: prototype
skills.purpose: Use when a throwaway prototype is the fastest way to answer a design question.

skills.name: research
skills.purpose: Use when the user asks a question that needs investigation against primary sources and citations.

skills.name: tdd
skills.purpose: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix and a test-driven approach is appropriate.

skills.name: teach
skills.purpose: Use when the user wants to learn a skill or concept through a guided, multi-step session.

skills.name: tool-and-skill-discovery
skills.purpose: Use when the user asks how to do something, needs the right skill or tool, or no skill seems to match the task.

skills.name: using-skills
skills.purpose: Use when starting any conversation and before taking any non-trivial action.

skills.name: ontology-validator
skills.purpose: Use when validating tool outputs or data against a domain ontology or structured knowledge base. Ensures entities, types, and relations are consistent before side effects.

skills.name: secure-defaults-check
skills.purpose: Use when checking that a project or change follows secure defaults before committing or deploying.

skills.name: api-context-spec
skills.purpose: Use when generating or maintaining OpenAPI specs as context for AI agents. Ensures API contracts are explicit, versioned, and machine-readable.

skills.name: wait-what
skills.purpose: Use when the last message did not land and needs to be re-explained or re-pitched.

skills.name: wizard
skills.purpose: Use when a human must walk through a manual procedure such as provisioning, credentials, or a one-off cutover.

skills.name: writing-for-agents
skills.purpose: Use when creating or editing skills, `.devin/global_rules.md` / `.devin/rules/*.md` rules, or other docs an agent must read.

skills.name: writing-skills
skills.purpose: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment.

skills.name: obsidian-workflow
skills.purpose: Use when the user wants to build or update a local codebase wiki in Obsidian, reorganize/refactor an Obsidian vault or docs folder, audit/validate Obsidian project wikis, or compare wiki knowledge across sessions. Four modes: Build, Reorganize, Audit, Cross-session.

skills.name: data-analyst
skills.purpose: Use when the user asks to query a database, analyze data, create charts, or asks business questions about data. SQL-first exploration via MCP data sources.

skills.name: playbook
skills.purpose: Use when the user wants to create, refine, or use a reusable playbook for repeated tasks. Structured prompt template with Procedure, Specs, Advice, Forbidden Actions.

skills.name: continuous-improvement
skills.purpose: Use when starting a self-improvement session. Enforces FASE 0 deep research and the 10-step improvement loop so no step is skipped, no phantom failure is invented, and every change is validated with held-out tests.

skills.name: impeccable
skills.purpose: Use when the user asks for UI/UX work, wants to fix or polish a page/component, or when an interface looks bland, inconsistent, or like a default template.

skills.name: ai-coding-dictionary
skills.purpose: Use when the user asks about AI coding jargon, wants to clarify a term like context engineering, harness engineering, prompt engineering, or agent harness, or when the agent needs to agree on a term definition before continuing a technical discussion.

skills.name: deploy
skills.purpose: Use when the user wants to release, deploy, rollback, or verify a deployment pipeline. Covers CI/CD gates, environment checks, canary/blue-green, and post-deploy smoke tests.

skills.name: security-audit
skills.purpose: Use when the user wants to audit code, dependencies, or infrastructure for security issues. Covers SAST, dependency scanning, secret leak detection, and OWASP-style checks.

skills.name: performance
skills.purpose: Use when the user wants to profile, optimize, load-test, or measure the performance of code, queries, or infrastructure.

skills.name: a11y-audit
skills.purpose: Use when the user wants to check a frontend for accessibility. Covers keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels, color contrast, focus management, and WCAG alignment.

skills.name: api-design
skills.purpose: Use when the user wants to design, review, or document an API. Covers REST, OpenAPI, versioning, error models, contract testing, and authentication.

skills.name: database
skills.purpose: Use when the user wants to design, migrate, query, or optimize a database. Covers schema design, migrations, query review, indexing, and data integrity.

skills.name: e2e-testing
skills.purpose: Use when the user wants to add, run, or debug end-to-end tests. Covers Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, happy paths, critical user journeys, and CI integration.

skills.name: docker
skills.purpose: Use when the user wants to build, run, compose, or deploy containers. Covers Dockerfiles, docker compose, images, volumes, networks, and basic Kubernetes manifests.

skills.name: i18n
skills.purpose: Use when the user wants to add or review internationalization and localization. Covers locale files, translation keys, pluralization, RTL, and date/number formatting.

skills.name: structured-knowledge-extraction
skills.purpose: Use when extracting entities, relations, evidence, and provenance from Markdown or plain text into a typed, versioned knowledge graph under `.devin/`.

skills.name: youtube-fetcher
skills.purpose: Use when you need to turn a YouTube URL and provider-supplied caption/metadata JSON into a raw, timestamped transcript + metadata Markdown note under `.devin/notes/youtube/` for later structured extraction, without auto-installing dependencies, invoking yt-dlp/Whisper, or calling the network.

skills.name: leo
skills.purpose: Use when routing and orchestrating any work across this Devin bundle through one universal entry point, including direct specialist skills, multi-skill flows, and local AFK issues.

skills.name: computer-use
skills.purpose: Use when you need to see or control the local screen — screenshots, mouse clicks/movement, typing text and hotkeys. GUI automation for desktop apps and browsers, replicating Devin Cloud Computer Use in the CLI.

skills.name: context-hygiene
skills.purpose: Use when context is growing large or the agent forgets earlier instructions, when deciding clear vs compact, when processing documents/logs >50k tokens, when monitoring token cost or limiting subagent fan-out, when choosing a reasoning effort level, or when reducing token/compute/MCP costs. Covers lost-in-the-middle, context folding (RLM), cost guards, and difficulty-matched effort.

skills.name: memory-management
skills.purpose: Use when deciding whether to use cross-session agent memory (MEMORY.md, auto-memory), when auto-memory seems stale or preferences leak across tasks, or when the session produces knowledge worth remembering (answered questions, business rules, conventions, failed approaches, decisions). Covers memory hygiene (stateless vs managed vs naive) and capturing plain-text notes under .devin/ with user approval.

skills.name: mcp-governance
skills.purpose: Use when considering adding an MCP server, when context feels bloated with tool definitions, when auditing which servers consume the most context budget, before committing mcp_config.json changes, or when deciding which servers to keep active per task. Estimates per-server tool-definition token cost and guides lazy enablement.

skills.name: planning
skills.purpose: Use when turning conversation into a written spec/PRD, breaking a plan or spec into independent traceable tickets, writing a concrete task-by-task implementation plan, when a decision needs external input via a questionnaire, or when planning work too large for one session as a map of decision tickets (wayfinding).

skills.name: intake
skills.purpose: Use when estimating the size of a task or PR and deciding whether to split it, when capturing and validating the "intent" field in tickets/specs/PRDs before implementation, or when moving issues and external PRs through triage states (categorise, verify, grill, write agent-ready briefs).

skills.name: execution
skills.purpose: Use when executing a written implementation plan with checkpoints, when implementing a feature/fix from a spec or tickets, when deciding how much human review and upfront planning a task needs, or when working unattended through local Markdown issues in a blocking DAG (AFK loop).

skills.name: gates
skills.purpose: Use when about to claim work is complete/fixed/passing, when a task risks agent laziness (large, multi-step, previously half-done, or with acceptance criteria), or when running long-horizon/unattended work where quality must be verified before proceeding. Covers verification-before-completion, gates ledgers, and autonomous gate semantics.

skills.name: git-workflows
skills.purpose: Use when managing branches, writing commits, creating isolated worktrees for feature work, or resolving and verifying merge/rebase conflicts.

skills.name: architecture
skills.purpose: Use when designing modules, seams, and adapters, when evaluating module depth and identifying deepening opportunities in a codebase, or when modernizing legacy code incrementally (strangler-fig, seams, characterization tests, safe extraction).

skills.name: project-bootstrap
skills.purpose: Use when starting work on a project that lacks a `.devin/` configuration, when the user wants to add skills/hooks/rules/local tools systematically, when configuring a repo's issue tracker + triage labels + domain docs for the engineering skills, or when setting up Husky pre-commit hooks with lint-staged/typecheck/tests.

skills.name: devin-config
skills.purpose: Use when evolving the agent's capabilities with a new skill, custom subagent, plugin, hook, MCP server, or project rule — or when auditing/managing a project's `.devin/` configuration, producing deterministic read-only reports, detecting broken references/duplicates/divergences, and generating plans that persist under `.devin/` only after approval.

skills.name: debugging
skills.purpose: Use when the user says 'diagnose', 'debug this', reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow, when encountering a bug/test failure/unexpected behavior and a fix is not yet obvious, or when CI is failing and the cause needs to be found across builds, jobs, or environments.

scripts.name: _hookrun.py
scripts.purpose: Shared in-process hook runner — merges N hook checks into one spawn

scripts.name: architecture-gate.py
scripts.purpose: PreToolUse hook — blocks source edits in projects lacking .devin/ARCHITECTURE_MANIFEST.md

scripts.name: behavioral-nudge.py
scripts.purpose: PostToolUse hook — injects behavioral reminders

scripts.name: check-ai-signature.py
scripts.purpose: PreCommit hook — blocks AI signatures in commits

scripts.name: check-push-green.py
scripts.purpose: PrePush hook — blocks push when held-out tests fail

scripts.name: constraint-pinning.py
scripts.purpose: PostCompaction/UserPromptSubmit hook — re-injects pinned constraints

scripts.name: context-budget.py
scripts.purpose: SessionStart hook — reports AGENTS.md token cost

scripts.name: context-pressure.py
scripts.purpose: PostToolUse hook — estimates cumulative context-window pressure and warns at thresholds

scripts.name: destructive-gate.py
scripts.purpose: PreToolUse hook — gates destructive operations

scripts.name: memory-post-edit.py
scripts.purpose: PostToolUse hook — injects .devin/memory/ notes after write/edit based on cues.path

scripts.name: memory-post-exec.py
scripts.purpose: PostToolUse hook — injects .devin/memory/ notes after exec based on cues.symbol/keyword

scripts.name: memory-retrieval.py
scripts.purpose: UserPromptSubmit hook — cue-anchored retrieval from .devin/memory/ notes

scripts.name: memory-stop.py
scripts.purpose: Stop hook — logs .devin/memory/ state and prompts session capture review

scripts.name: mermaid-parse-check.js
scripts.purpose: Validator — Node.js Mermaid parser for syntax validation (helper, not counted in script_count)

scripts.name: post-exec.py
scripts.purpose: PostToolUse exec consolidated checks (silent-error+context-pressure+memory-post-exec)

scripts.name: pre-exec-guard.py
scripts.purpose: PreToolUse exec consolidated guard (destructive+arch+signature+push-green+tool-args)

scripts.name: pre-write-guard.py
scripts.purpose: PreToolUse write/edit/notebook_edit consolidated guard (arch+tool-args[+signature+mermaid])

scripts.name: refine-review-prompt.py
scripts.purpose: Refine mode — generates review prompts for self-improvement

scripts.name: render-user-hooks.py
scripts.purpose: Install-time renderer — expands hooks.v1.json into user-level config.json hooks

scripts.name: session-start.py
scripts.purpose: SessionStart consolidated hook (constraint-pinning+context-budget)

scripts.name: silent-error-review.py
scripts.purpose: PostToolUse hook — detects silent errors in tool output

scripts.name: stop-guard.py
scripts.purpose: Stop consolidated guard (signature+refine-review+memory-stop)

scripts.name: user-prompt.py
scripts.purpose: UserPromptSubmit consolidated hook (constraint-pinning+nudge+memory-retrieval)

scripts.name: validate-mermaid.py
scripts.purpose: Validator — checks Mermaid syntax in wiki diagrams

scripts.name: validate-refinement-evidence.py
scripts.purpose: Validator — checks refinements.log.jsonl for phantom guardrails

scripts.name: validate-skill-format.py
scripts.purpose: Validator — checks SKILL.md frontmatter and format

scripts.name: validate-tool-args.py
scripts.purpose: Validator — checks tool argument schemas
